subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should structured usage become an additive part of `session_status.details`, or should OpenClaw expose a separate agent-facing session-usage tool?
rationale: Both shapes are technically feasible, but maintainers must choose the durable tool contract, visibility boundary, and semantics for transcript totals versus provider quota and billing data before implementation.

options.title: Extend `session_status.details`
options.body: Add stable structured usage fields to the existing status tool while preserving its rendered text and access checks.

options.title: Add a dedicated usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` lightweight and expose transcript totals, last-turn usage, and provider windows through a separate agent-facing tool.

options.title: Keep usage gateway-only
options.body: Decline an agent-facing usage API and continue requiring external consumers to use gateway RPCs or transcript processing.

recommendation.title: Extend `session_status.details`
recommendation.body: Add stable structured usage fields to the existing status tool while preserving its rendered text and access checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history and the prior issue review connect this person most directly to the `session_status` contract and its product boundary.
